hints.text: To reverse a linked list, maintain three pointers: `prev` (initially null), `curr` (initially head), and `next`.
At each step, save `next = curr.next`, set `curr.next = prev`, then advance `prev = curr` and `curr = next`.
When `curr` becomes null, `prev` is the new head of the reversed list.
